message.jaymospowers.texture_look.vanill: Vanilla look: the pack's retexture packs are off. Our own items, blocks and mobs keep their art. /texturelook reason switches them back on.
message.jaymospowers.texture_look.reason: Reason look: the pack's retexture packs are back on (any that are missing download in the background).
message.jaymospowers.texture_look.is_van: You're on the vanilla look. /texturelook reason for the pack's own look.
message.jaymospowers.texture_look.is_rea: You're on the Reason look. /texturelook vanilla switches the pack's retexture packs off.
